questions.question: What is the octopus Advertising Platform?
questions.answer: octopus is an integrated digital marketing platform that simplifies advertising for your business. Instead of managing multiple ad platforms individually, our team of experts distributes your ad content across a wide network of digital channels to reach the largest possible audience of your potential customers.

questions.question: Where will my ad appear?
questions.answer:
Sponsored campaigns or social media distribution such as:
- Snapchat
- X (Twitter)
- Google Ads
- TikTok
- Facebook & Instagram
- SEO (Search Engine Optimization)
- Groups
- Forums
- Classified Ads

questions.question: How quickly will I receive a response?
questions.answer: We typically respond to all inquiries within 24 hours during business days.

questions.question: What payment methods do you accept?
questions.answer: We accept all major credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfers for enterprise accounts.

questions.question: Do you offer refunds for unused credits?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer refunds for unused credits within 30 days of purchase. Contact support for assistance.

questions.question: How do I upgrade my plan?
questions.answer: You can upgrade your plan at any time from your billing settings. The upgrade will be prorated based on your current billing cycle.

questions.question: Do you offer refunds?
questions.answer: Yes, we offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans. Contact our support team for assistance.

questions.question: How do I create my first ad campaign?
questions.answer: Navigate to the Campaigns section and click 'Create New Ad'. Follow our step-by-step wizard to set up your targeting, budget, and creative content.

questions.question: What targeting options are available?
questions.answer: We offer demographic targeting, interest-based targeting, location targeting, and behavioral targeting to help you reach your ideal audience.

questions.question: How long does it take for ads to be approved?
questions.answer: Most ads are reviewed and approved within 24 hours. Complex campaigns may take up to 48 hours for review.

questions.question: How do I reset my password?
questions.answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email address.

questions.question: Is my data secure?
questions.answer: Yes, we use enterprise-grade security measures including SSL encryption, regular security audits, and comply with GDPR and CCPA regulations.

questions.question: Can I delete my account?
questions.answer: Yes, you can delete your account from the account settings. Please note this action is irreversible and all data will be permanently removed.

privacyTerms.title: Privacy Policy & Terms of Service
privacyTerms.subtitle: Understanding how we protect your data and the terms that govern our service.
privacyTerms.introductionContent: This Privacy Policy describes how Octopus Ad ('we', 'our', or 'us') collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use our advertising platform and services.
privacyTerms.personalInfoContent: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, make purchases, or contact support. This includes your name, email address, billing information, and communications.
privacyTerms.usageDataContent: We automatically collect information about how you use our service, including ad performance metrics, click-through rates, and user interactions with your advertisements.
privacyTerms.technicalContent: We collect technical data including IP addresses, browser type, device information, and cookies to improve our service and ensure security.
privacyTerms.dataUseService: To provide and maintain our advertising services
privacyTerms.dataUseCommunication: To communicate with you about your account and our services
privacyTerms.dataUseImprovement: To improve and personalize your experience
privacyTerms.dataUseSecurity: To detect and prevent fraud and ensure platform security
privacyTerms.dataUseLegal: To comply with legal obligations and protect our rights
privacyTerms.securityContent: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encryption, secure servers, and regular security audits. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacyTerms.rightsAccess: Access and review your personal data
privacyTerms.rightsDeletion: Request deletion of your personal data
privacyTerms.rightsPortability: Export your data in a machine-readable format
privacyTerms.rightsObjection: Object to processing of your personal data
privacyTerms.contactContent: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact our privacy team:
privacyTerms.acceptanceContent: By accessing and using Octopus Ad's advertising platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our service.
privacyTerms.serviceContent: Octopus Ad provides an advertising platform that allows users to create, manage, and track digital marketing campaigns. Our service includes ad creation tools, targeting options, analytics, and billing management.
privacyTerms.responsibilitiesAccurate: Provide accurate and up-to-date account information
privacyTerms.responsibilitiesLawful: Use the service only for lawful purposes
privacyTerms.responsibilitiesSecure: Maintain the security of your account credentials
privacyTerms.responsibilitiesRespect: Respect the rights and privacy of others

privacyTerms.paymentBilling: All fees are billed in advance and are non-refundable except as required by law. You authorize us to charge your selected payment method for all fees incurred.
privacyTerms.paymentRefunds: Refunds may be provided at our sole discretion for unused advertising credits within 30 days of purchase, subject to our refund policy.
privacyTerms.intellectualContent: All content, features, and functionality of our service are owned by Octopus Ad and are protected by copyright, trademark, and other intellectual property laws. You retain ownership of your advertising content.
privacyTerms.liabilityContent: Octopus Ad shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages resulting from your use of our service. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the 12 months preceding the claim.
privacyTerms.terminationContent: We may terminate or suspend your account at any time for violation of these terms. You may terminate your account at any time by contacting support. Upon termination, your right to use the service ceases immediately.
